name: lidocaine + magnesium chloride + menthol
uses: Uses Temporarily relieves minor pain associated with • neuropathy, nerve discomfort, arthritis, simple backache, muscle strains, sprains, bruises, or cramps.
otcwarn: Warnings For external use only Do not use On damaged or broken skin. When using this product Avoid contact with the eyes. Do not bandage tightly. Stop use and ask a doctor if Rash or irritation develops and lasts. Condition worsens, or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. If pregnant or breast-feeding , ask a health professional before use.
